name: io.github.1436941541/firsttripchina
title: FirstTripChina — China Travel Visa, Apps & Rail Guide
description: Check China visa-free & 240h transit rules, foreign app/eSIM status, and English travel guides.

tools.name: check_china_visa_eligibility
tools.description: Check China visa-free entry (30-day unilateral/mutual), 240-hour visa-free transit, or regular visa requirements by passport country, trip purpose, stay length, and onward third-country ticket. Backed by https://firsttripchina.com/tools/china-visa-checker.

country.description: Passport country ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. 'US', 'GB', 'DE', 'AU', 'SG', 'JP') or English country name (e.g. 'United States', 'France').

length_of_stay_days.description: Planned length of stay in mainland China in days (e.g. 10, 14, 30). Defaults to 10.

has_third_country_ticket.description: Whether the traveler holds a confirmed onward ticket to a third country/region (Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan count as third regions for 240h transit). Defaults to false.

tools.name: check_china_apps
tools.description: Check whether foreign apps (WhatsApp, Google Maps, Instagram, Gmail, Uber, ChatGPT, banking apps, etc.) work in mainland China under travel eSIM/roaming vs. local SIM or hotel WiFi, with local alternatives and pre-trip action steps. Backed by https://firsttripchina.com/tools/china-app-checker.

apps.description: List of app IDs or names to check (e.g. ['whatsapp', 'google-maps', 'instagram', 'uber']). Omit to check the most popular traveler apps.

connection_method.description: Planned internet connection in China: 'roaming' (international roaming or travel eSIM), 'local' (Chinese SIM), 'wifi' (hotel/cafe WiFi), or 'unsure' (compares roaming vs. local). Defaults to 'unsure'.

tools.name: search_china_travel_guides
tools.description: Search FirstTripChina's verified English travel guides (high-speed trains, airports, metro systems, Alipay/WeChat Pay, weather by month, itineraries) and return summaries with direct URLs on firsttripchina.com.

limit.description: Maximum number of guides to return (1–10). Defaults to 5.

tools.name: get_china_destination_guide
tools.description: Get city destination overview, highlights, and direct URL for major Chinese travel hubs on firsttripchina.com (beijing, shanghai, chengdu, chongqing, xian, guilin, hangzhou, lijiang, suzhou, zhangjiajie). Omit city to list all published destination hubs.

city.description: Optional city slug or name (e.g. 'beijing', 'shanghai', 'chengdu', 'xian', 'zhangjiajie'). Omit to list all available destinations.
